description: A chest-high freezer case with a fogged glass lid and a compressor loud enough to hear from the sales floor. Frost has crept up the inside of the glass in a slow white curtain nobody scrapes anymore. Whatever's in here left the temperature charts behind a long time ago.
name: Ironchill Deep-Freeze Unit
